Vivek / team — finance assessment:

We typically avoid Net-90 because it materially extends DSO and increases credit risk. That said, for renewals with strong payment history and a valid PO we can accept an exception with these controls:

- Require an executed PO at signing that explicitly references the Redwood SOW and invoicing schedule.
- Add a 15% retainage to the first invoice for 60 days, released on first full payment cycle (minimum protection).
- Apply standard late fee clause from our master terms and require a single point of contact for remittance.
- Finance holds right to pause service in the event of non-payment after 120 days (documented escalation to CSM).

If the account refuses PO + retainage, we should offer Net-60 + quarterly invoicing instead. Approving Net-90 without any upfront protections is not recommended.

I am okay to approve Net-90 as a one-off for StellarApps if Marissa confirms they will provide an executed PO before we go live and we add the retainage language to the addendum. Please escalate to Rishi for final sign-off on the wording and any exceptions to standard credit limits.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Finance
